scope: Bounded fertilizer and soil-amendment catalog proposals for deterministic simulation. Entries are abstract material classes, not products, formulations, endorsements, prescriptions, environmental approvals or safety determinations.

owner_bindings.candidate_behavior: Reference owner state only; do not copy or mutate soil truth.
Return response projections only; do not create a new Plant owner or species.
Submit proposed paired deltas and accept owner validation; never persist authoritative balances.
Reference plot and crop IDs and propose an application envelope; do not change Agriculture state.
Require owner lot, order, warehouse and transport references; do not create inventory truth.
Require a validated work-shift reference and owner-native worker-minute accounting.
Request a decision only; no proposal grants a right or capability.
Reference lot, inventory and ledger IDs only; do not create balances, prices, costs or entries.

separation_contract.soil_amendment: A structural or organic carrier transfer proposed to change a soil-state proxy. It is not automatically a nutrient input, fertilizer, compost, contaminant remedy or owner-approved soil change.
separation_contract.nutrient_input: A named nutrient-proxy mass transfer into Ecology custody. It cannot appear from an Agriculture facility unit or a fertility score without an owner-approved unit adapter.
separation_contract.fertilizer_inventory: An Economy and Supply Chain lot reference. Inventory quantity, ownership, price, quality and location remain foreign truth.
separation_contract.compost_boundary: No compost production, decomposition kinetics, microbial process or compost-quality claim is modeled in this task.
separation_contract.product_boundary: Proposal IDs are abstract simulation classes and are not commercial products or endorsements.

numeric_parameter_contract.validation_rule: Every catalog numeric parameter is a simulation proposal and validation_required is true.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a closed mass-accounting basis for an abstract dry lot, not an application amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: A reference lot can be mistaken for a purchase or field recommendation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Bounds a deterministic transfer from storage custody to named recovery or release custody.
numeric_parameters.risk: Real storage behavior depends on packaging, climate, handling and material properties.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Supports paired transport-loss custody without allowing material to disappear.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proposal is not a logistics loss estimate.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps material retained by equipment in an explicit custody pool.
numeric_parameters.risk: Equipment-specific residue requires measurement and owner validation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires explicit Physical Labor capacity for storage, transport handoff and application.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a staffing or occupational-safety estimate.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Creates a finite energy debit paired with a named dissipation or storage credit.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proxy is not equipment power demand or fuel guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a closed mass basis for the liquid fixture and is not an application amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: A reference batch can be mistaken for real mixing guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Bounds a contained storage-loss scenario with named destination custody.
numeric_parameters.risk: Container compatibility and real leakage behavior are not represented.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Supports deterministic transport custody and spill-recovery scenarios.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a transport safety or loss estimate.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps metering and container residue as explicit material custody.
numeric_parameters.risk: Real residue depends on equipment and formulation properties.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires an explicit non-overlapping labor shift for handling and metered application.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a staffing or exposure-control recommendation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a finite energy proxy for pumping or metering events with paired accounting.
numeric_parameters.risk: No real pump, pressure, electricity or fuel requirement is established.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a closed fixture basis for a received amendment lot, not a production recipe or field amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: The abstract lot could be mistaken for compost or soil-treatment guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Bounds moisture, structural mass and nutrient transfers to named storage-loss pools.
numeric_parameters.risk: No decomposition, microbial or storage-quality process is validated.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires structural carrier, nutrient and water losses to retain destination custody.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a transport or containment estimate.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps moist amendment residue in a named equipment-cleanout pool.
numeric_parameters.risk: No equipment suitability or cleaning procedure is approved.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires explicit labor for material handling without asserting a staffing level.
numeric_parameters.risk: Real handling effort, ergonomics and hazards are unvalidated.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides finite handling energy with paired dissipation accounting.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proxy is not machinery, fuel or electricity guidance.

inventory_lot_reference_contract.rule: Candidate files may reference owner lot IDs and propose paired deltas but never create authoritative inventory, ownership, quality, price or ledger state.

provenance.usage: Authoritative owner map and fertilizer batch boundary.
Storage, transport, dependency and lot custody gates.
Worker timeline, shift and capacity owner boundary.
CIVILIZATION_ECONOMY_ALPHA inventory and ledger owner, including FERTILIZER resource ID.
AGRICULTURE_ALPHA crop, plot, facility and event owner boundary.
